caption: The drawing shows a single wooden table with turned legs and a rectangular top. The tabletop has a marbled or patterned surface in shades of cream, light brown, and beige. The body of the table, including the sides and the single drawer, is dark brown. The drawer is centered and features two brass or gold-colored circular drawer pulls with drop handles. The underpart of the table features scalloped cutouts along the horizontal apron. The four legs are evenly spaced at each corner, having a baluster or turned design, and are connected near the lower end by a set of curved wooden stretchers that join at a central turned element, which extends downward like a finial. The background of the drawing is plain and light, focusing attention entirely on the table. There are no other objects or decorations in the image.
title: Tea Table
